article_notes: 22 B. canis dogs (Zagreb faculty clinic; PCR confirmed) in three kidney-function groups (A n=6, B n=10, C n=6) plus 12 healthy controls; urine metabolomics. All group tests (Kruskal-Wallis, ANOVA) include the control group; Table 1 rows are therefore descriptive C vs A. Text-stated pairwise metabolite results are extracted with low/medium confidence. Most metabolite-level numbers are in supplementary tables not available. Same Zagreb group as other urine/proteomics babesiosis studies; cohort overlap possible but not stated.

severity_definitions.label: group C (azotaemic, UPC > 1) vs group B (non-azotaemic, UPC > 0.5) vs group A (non-azotaemic, UPC < 0.5)
severity_definitions.definition: Three ordered groups of B. canis dogs by kidney function at admission: A, serum creatinine < 140 umol/L and UPC < 0.5 (n=6); B, non-azotaemic with UPC > 0.5 (n=10); C, azotaemic (creatinine > 140 umol/L) with UPC > 1 (n=6). Severe = group C; comparison = group A unless stated. UPC thresholds follow ACVIM/IRIS guidance cited in the introduction.
severity_definitions.comparison_group: group A, non-azotaemic with UPC < 0.5 (n=6); group B (n=10) intermediate
severity_definitions.quote: group A consisted of six non-azotemic dogs (serum creatinine < 140 μmol/L) with a normal urine protein to creatinine ratio (UPC < 0.5); group B of 10 non-azotemic dogs with UPC > 0.5; and group C of six azotemic dogs (serum creatinine > 140 μmol/L) with UPC > 1.
severity_definitions.definition_source: author-defined (creatinine 140 umol/L and ACVIM proteinuria UPC thresholds)

severity_definitions.complication: renal proteinuria (UPC as a continuous measure)
severity_definitions.label: urine protein:creatinine ratio (continuous)
severity_definitions.definition: Pearson correlation of targeted urinary metabolites with UPC, used by the authors as the conventional measure of kidney dysfunction. Whether healthy controls were included in the correlation is not stated.
severity_definitions.quote: Correlations between the metabolites identified by the targeted approach and UPC (conventional parameter) were calculated by Pearson’s correlation coefficient.

severity_definitions.label: kidney dysfunction (ROC)
severity_definitions.definition: ROC analysis of targeted urinary metabolites 'in detecting kidney dysfunction'. The positive and negative groups of the ROC are not stated (probably groups B and C vs group A and/or controls).
severity_definitions.quote: receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves were applied to investigate the clinical diagnostic potentials of these metabolites.
